The current Prime Minister of India is Narendra Modi, serving since May 26, 2014. He has been actively involved in national and international dialogues as reflected by his engagements with various world leaders during Pariksha Pe Charcha events (NarendraModi.in).

Actionable Next Steps:
- To stay updated on Prime Minister Narendra Modi's latest initiatives, visit the official website for live event updates and speeches ([PrimeMinisterOfIndia](https://www.narendramodi.in/)).
- Engage with India’s diplomatic efforts by understanding its foreign relations through the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) portal at [http://mea.gov.in/](http://mea.gov.in/).
- Follow public grievances and governmental updates from Pariksha Pe Charcha on national issues ([KnowIndia](https://www.knowindia.nic.in/)).

In conclusion, Narendra Modi has been a pivotal figure in India’s government and political scene since 2014, with numerous speeches and diplomatic engagements to his name which demonstrate an active role on both national and international stages. Staying informed through official channels is crucial for understanding current events affecting the country's direction.
